correctness.rationale: Every Hopf torus weight (a,b) satisfying ell-|a|-|b|=2s>=0 occurs exactly once in the degree-ell scalar harmonic basis, with restriction coefficient P_s^{(|a|,|b|)}(0). Boundary weights give all |k| from ell to 2ell. The central congruence proof handles all ell mod 3, checks the unique ell=16 zero in the s=2 construction by the nonzero s=5 Jacobi factor, and identifies only the stated low-degree holes. Reducing character weights modulo N proves rank. The independent Chebyshev/Laurent exact-integer checker compared 61 degrees and 3,843 finite cyclic ranks; it corroborates but does not prove the universal statement.

value.rationale: The natural first nonsynchronous (1,2) circle action on the Clifford torus models angularly coupled spherical samples. A complete all-N, all-degree exact harmonic interpolation rank and frequency support law identifies isolated geometric cancellation holes, including a mathematically meaningful rank reentry (N=6 degrees 3/4/5: 6/5/6). It guides identifiability limits; the precise classification and the unexpected nonmonotonicity are more than routine linear-algebra bookkeeping. Conditioning and other winding types remain unproved.
